sources.what: Naver Commerce API live response (category 50004528, KITCHEN_UTENSILS). Sending both releaseDate and releaseDateText was refused with an XOR constraint message: 'XOR — releaseDate, releaseDateText 둘 중 하나만 입력해 주세요.' Sending releaseDateText alone succeeded with HTTP 200. This establishes releaseDate XOR releaseDateText for KITCHEN_UTENSILS.

Earlier audit finding for ETC: afterServiceDirector and customerServicePhoneNumber are mutually exclusive (A/S contact single-channel exposure policy). The live API refuses when both are present. This was previously handled as a code special-case in naver_client._enforce_notice_as_contact_exclusive for ETC alone; it is now recorded here as data so the same mechanism covers both confirmed cases.

note: 확인된 것만 기록한다. 다른 타입의 필드를 보고 '이것도 XOR 같다' 로 채우지 않는다. 확인되지 않은 관계를 기록하면 규제 필드 오신고가 된다. XOR 그룹은 '이 필드들 중 정확히 하나' 를 뜻한다 — 둘 다 비면 미제공(차단), 하나만 있으면 충족, 둘 다 있으면 위반(네이버가 거절).
